claims.claim: Body, engine and suspension parts for all model of Honda, Acura and Toyota cars and SUVs
claims.evidence: The witness only saw a car front/hood area with partial text “HONDA AND ACURA”; no parts inventory, labels, or proof of what exact parts are included.

risks.risk: Unclear whether the item is a whole car or specific body/engine/suspension parts (the photos show only the front/hood area of a blue car).
risks.proof: A full set of photos showing the exact item(s) being sold laid out (e.g., engine components, suspension parts, body panels) OR clear shots of the complete vehicle from multiple angles including the VIN/plate area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a partial/uncertain listing (front/hood area only) with major uncertainty on completeness and usability.

risks.risk: Possible body repair/paintwork or protective film indicating damage not shown (plastic/film over parts could be packaging or could hide dents/scratches).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of panel gaps, paint condition, and any repaired areas with the protective film removed (or a video showing the film and the underlying surface).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for bodywork uncertainty (assume possible repair/paint issues).

risks.risk: Engine and suspension condition unknown (no evidence the engine runs, no under-hood or suspension component condition shown).
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting/running (cold start if possible), plus under-hood and undercarriage shots showing suspension components (shocks/struts/control arms) and any leaks/corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified mechanical condition (assume not working/needs overhaul until proven).

risks.risk: Make/model/year and compatibility unknown (witness could not read exact model/year; seller claims “all models”).
risks.proof: Photos of the vehicle identification details (VIN/plate) and the dashboard/odometer screen, plus engine bay ID tags.
risks.if_unproven: Price with compatibility risk (assume limited fitment and require matching verification).

risks.risk: Accident/structural damage and alignment unknown (no chassis/frame or wheel alignment evidence shown).
risks.proof: Photos of wheel alignment marks, straight-edge/underbody inspection points, and a body panel alignment check; ideally a mechanic inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for hidden accident damage (assume structural issues possible).

risks.proof: Clear photos of registration papers, seller’s ID, and any transfer documents; VIN match to documents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as high legal/transfer risk (assume documentation may be incomplete).

proof_requests: Confirm whether you are selling the whole car or specific parts; send photos of the exact parts included (engine/suspension/body panels) laid out and labeled.
Send clear photos of the make/model/year and VIN/plate area (not just the front/hood close-up).
Send a video of the engine starting/running and a short walkaround showing no hidden damage.
Send under-hood and undercarriage photos showing suspension components and any leaks/corrosion.
Send photos of tyres tread, brakes, and any dashboard warning lights/error codes.
Send registration/ownership documents and ensure VIN matches the car.
response.reason: The witness can only confirm a blue car front/hood area with partial “HONDA AND ACURA” text; the seller’s claim about body/engine/suspension parts and “all models” is not supported by the shown evidence. Without proof of what exactly is being sold and its condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
